column1: # CCS simple-baseline round, 2026-11-01 (runs/ccs-simple-20261101/LOG.md): exactly identified refits (8 parameters,
# 8 targets, default solver) from the September fit (runs/exact-polish-base), ψ = 0, panel.sh with --polish
# (PANEL_MAX_ITER=30) on the frozen tree CODE=…/runs/_code/ccs-r1, PANEL_OUT=…/runs/exp-ccs-simple/refit. They complete
# the 2×2 {K_d 1, 12} × {ρ 1, 0.3} of runs/exp-ccs/refit (ccs1_psi0 and ccs12_psi0 are the ρ = 1 corners; ccs1_psi0 is
# the simple model) and add the efficient comparator with the same CFR effectiveness concept. Under CCS the draw's CFR
# noise and the CFR bridge use the same ρ (--external ccs_rho = --measure cfr_rho = 0.3: no problem_setup warning).
# The CCS cases fix the grid pad as cases_ccs_refit.tsv does (0.6 at K_d = 1, 0.3 at K_d = 12): ρ = 0.3 leaves SD(ln r)
# pinned by the CFR target and makes the draw nearly Gaussian (its standardized skewness × ρ³), so max |x| ≈ √3 SD(ln r);
# at the development candidate SD(ln r) is (0.149, 0.168) at K_d 1 and (0.041, 0.046) at K_d 12 (runs/exp-ccs/dev),
# max |x| ≈ 0.29 and 0.08. The pad check at the converged refits is runs/ccs-simple-20261101/padcheck.sh.
